payload.value:
## Context

The owner narrowed the goal on 2026-11-13.
"i only have 1 thing i need finished: the new work tracker using backlog-vault, and migrating at least one repository to it, like Development repo"
The Orchestrator confirmed the development-only rehearsal scope on 2026-11-13.
Basicly, handily and terminal retain their current trackers.

## Scope

Prepare part 1 from landed cut B while cut C2 lands.
Run part 2 after cut C2 is green.
The Orchestrator relayed this owner decision on 2026-11-13 at 22:01 UTC.
Keep scratch folders for the handover. Remove them only with the owner's word.
Prove deterministic canonical bytes, unchanged record ids, event accounting, integrity, process evidence and required template metadata.
Check whether the old workspace beads records already exist in its ledger.
Codex-2 owns the standalone lifecycle and old-ledger consumer comparison proofs.
Prepare exact release and development cutover commands, visibility preflight, checks and rollback.
Show the runbook and measured rehearsal counts before the first live step.
The owner approved the conditional release and development switch in this session on 2026-11-13.
Stop and ask the owner on any refusal, failed check or differing count.
Keep no private id map, as the owner selected.
Wider rehearsals and other repository cutovers remain deferred in a linked record.
